magic_items.name: Circlet of Persuasion
magic_items.description: While wearing this circlet, you have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

magic_items.name: Briarthorn Bracers
magic_items.description: These magically inscribed leather bracers afford the wearer a +1 bonus to AC. Undergrowth and forested conditions are not considered difficult terrain for the wearer.

magic_items.name: Hunter's Horn
magic_items.description: Blowing this horn summons 3 (1d4 + 1) eel hounds (effective only in the Summer Lands). Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 1 day has passed.

magic_items.name: Enchanted Shadow Box
magic_items.description: A small wooden box containing an enchanted shadow that functions like the spell darkness, centered on the box, except the area affected is a 60-foot-radius sphere. This is a one-use item worth 500 gp.

magic_items.name: +1 Mithral Chain Shirt
magic_items.description: Mentioned as available for sale by Ambertan.

magic_items.name: +1 Breastplate
magic_items.description: Mentioned as available for sale by Ambertan.

magic_items.name: +1 Shortsword
magic_items.description: +1 Shortsword. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. Like all the "enchanted" weapons here, the magic fades after 1–2 days.

magic_items.name: +1 Magical Weapons (temporary)
magic_items.description: The gnomes' goods include all types of +1 magical weapons: daggers, swords, axes, etc. These are all temporary enchantments that fade in a few days.

magic_items.name: The Queen's Token
magic_items.description: Made of red and yellow gold in the shape of a birch leaf, this broach for a cloak is equivalent to a periapt of health for anyone who wins it.
magic_items.source: Warlock Lairs: Into the Summer Lands p.42

magic_items.name: Ironbound chest
magic_items.description: Ironbound chest containing 500 gp.

magic_items.name: Moonstone
magic_items.description: Three 100-gp moonstones.

magic_items.name: +2 mithral chain shirt
magic_items.description: +2 mithral chain shirt.

magic_items.name: +2 magical weapon
magic_items.description: +2 magical weapon (tailored to the party).

magic_items.name: Crown of Mithral (Regalia of the Crawling Fey)
magic_items.description: A crown of mithral, part of the Regalia of the Crawling Fey. The crown is worth possibly more to a fey who understands its significance, but selling it also means selling the title of Lord/Lady of the Crawling Fey and giving up the spider-related abilities that come with it.

magic_items.name: Regalia of the Crawling Fey
magic_items.description: This mithral crown acts as a cloak of arachnida and grants advantage to Charisma (Persuasion) checks with spiders, ettercaps, and similar creatures. Additionally, such creatures always initially have a favorable attitude when interacting with the wearer and address the wearer as "your Majesty." The wearer can converse with such creatures, even if not normally able. The wearer loses 2 points of Intelligence when the regalia is worn. For those games using Status, the wearer gains the title "Lord or Lady of the Crawling Fey" and gains +3 Status among Fey Courts and +4 Status among Shadow Fey Courts.

magic_items.name: Orb of the Rushing Flood
magic_items.description: When worn, this encapsulates the wearer's hand in a sphere of pulsating blue light. Effect: This item acts as a ring of the ram.

magic_items.name: Crown of the River King
magic_items.description: When sat upon the brow, this circlet of sterling silver appears to sway and ripple, like sunlight on a stream. Effect: This crown acts as a cloak of displacement and grants the wearer the continuous effects of a water breathing spell. It grants advantage to Charisma (Persuasion) checks with sidhe and fey creatures in the Summer Lands. If worn along with the Orb of the Rushing Flood, its bearer is the River King and gains Innate Spellcasting abilities as described in his statistics. The character becomes an NPC under the DM's control if both are worn for more than 7 days. Sidhe within the Summer Lands pursue its bearer until it is surrendered.

magic_items.name: Mithral Necklace with Star-Emerald Pendant
magic_items.description: A mithral necklace with an enchanted, pulsing star-emerald pendant that has 3 charges and regains 1d3 charges daily at dawn. Each charge expended allows the wearer to cast water walk.

magic_items.name: +2 Mithral Armor
magic_items.description: A suit of +2 mithral armor (tailored to the group).

magic_items.name: +2 Vicious Sword
magic_items.description: A +2 vicious sword (tailored to the group) fashioned of magical, unmelting ice (treat as a silvered or cold iron weapon).

magic_items.name: Iceriver
magic_items.description: The sword is a +2 vicious greatsword made of unmelting ice (treat as a silvered or cold-iron weapon).
magic_items.source: Siege of the False Mill p.64

magic_items.name: Miller's Blessing (Fey Boon)
magic_items.description: A small pouch of silvery flour and can be used once to teleport a creature up to 25 feet away to a place with line of effect and line of sight as a bonus action.
magic_items.source: Siege of the False Mill p.64

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The frog makes one bite attack against a Small or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the frog, and it takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of each of the frog's turns. The frog can have only one target swallowed at a time. If the frog dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons

features.name: Clomping Boots
features.description: A redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

features.name: Red Cap
features.description: A redcap must soak its cap in the blood of a humanoid killed no more than an hour ago at least once every three days. If it goes more than 72 hours without doing so, the blood on its cap dries and the redcap gains one level of exhaustion every 24 hours. While the cap is dry, the redcap can't remove exhaustion by any means. All levels of exhaustion are removed immediately when the redcap soaks its cap in fresh blood. A redcap that dies as a result of this exhaustion crumbles to dust.

features.name: Solid Kick
features.description: A redcap can kick a creature within 5 feet as a bonus action. The kicked creature must make a successful DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The redcap makes two pike attacks and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage and the creature is bleeding profusely. A bleeding creature must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of its turn or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and continue bleeding. On a successful save the creature takes no necrotic damage and the effect ends. A creature takes only 10 (3d6) necrotic damage per turn from this effect no matter how many times it's been bitten, and a single successful saving throw ends all bleeding. Spending an action to make a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Medicine) check or any amount of magical healing also stops the bleeding. Constructs and undead are immune to the bleeding effect.

monsters.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14

features.name: Fog Vision
features.description: Tatzel sees normally through light or heavy obscurement caused by foliage or branches, fog, mist, clouds, or flying debris.

features.description: The death butterfly swarm's poison affects corporeal undead who are otherwise immune to poison.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

features.name: Weight of Wings
features.description: A creature in a space occupied by the death butterfly swarm has its speed reduced by half and must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature doesn't share a space with the

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: While the treant remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal tree.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes three slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., single target. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: A glass orb that acts as a brooch of shielding.

features.name: Potent Poison
features.description: Lord Peppick's poison affects corporeal undead who are otherwise immune to poison.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: Lord Peppick can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and he can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect.

features.name: Weight of Wings
features.description: A creature in a space occupied by Lord Peppick has its speed reduced by half and must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature doesn't share a space with Lord Peppick at the end of the creature's turn. If a creature succeeds on the saving throw, it is immune to Lord Peppick's blindness effect (but not the speed reduction) for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Lord Peppick makes a Bite attack against every target in his spaces.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 0 ft., every target in Lord Peppick's spaces. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) piercing damage, or 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage if he has half his hit points or fewer. The target also takes 17 (5d6) poison damage and becomes poisoned for 3 (1d4) rounds; a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw reduces poison damage by half and prevents the poisoned condition.

monsters.name: Nixie
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with cold-iron weapons

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
A nixie's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: animal friendship
3/day: charm person
1/day: water breathing

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The nixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.description:
The nixie sings a magical melody. Every humanoid and giant within 300 feet of the nixie that can hear the song must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the song ends. The nixie must take a bonus action on its subsequent turns to continue singing. It can stop singing at any time. The song ends if the nixie is incapacitated.

While charmed by the nixie, a target is incapacitated and ignores the songs of other nixies. If the charmed target is more than 5 feet away from the nixie, the target must move on its turn toward the nixie by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn't avoid opportunity attacks, but before moving into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the nixie, the target can repeat the saving throw. A charmed target can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If the saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it.

A target that successfully saves is immune to this nixie's song for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.description: The nixie magically polymorphs into a Medium or smaller sized aquatic beast, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the nixie's choice).

monsters.source: Chapter 6: Source of the River p.50

features.name: Alluring Presence
features.description: All humanoids within 30 feet of a lorelei who look directly at her must succeed on a DC 16 Charisma saving throw or be drawn to her in the most direct path, regardless of the danger. This compulsion fades once the person gets within 5 feet of the lorelei. A creature can avoid this effect for one full round by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn, but it then has disadvantage on any attacks or other rolls directed against the lorelei until the start of its next turn. A lorelei can suppress or resume this ability as a bonus action. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from the same lorelei for 24 hours.

features.name: Unearthly Grace
features.description: A lorelei applies her Charisma modifier to all her saving throws in place of the normal ability modifier.

features.name: Water Spirit
features.description: The lorelei is under the effect of freedom of movement whenever she is in contact with a body of water.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The lorelei is a 6th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She requires no material components to cast her spells. The lorelei has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): detect magic, guidance, light, mending, poison spray, prestidigitation
1st level (4 slots): comprehend languages, fog cloud, mage armor, ray of sickness
2nd level (3 slots): hold person, misty step, suggestion
3rd level (3 slots): hypnotic pattern, gaseous form, water walk

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: The lorelei targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see or hear the lorelei, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by the lorelei. The charmed target regards the lorelei as its one true love, to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the lorelei's control, it takes the lorelei's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: Gumphollow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Gumphollow makes two attacks, one with his morningstar and one with his sticky tongue.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sticky Tongue
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack. +3 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: A creature hit by Gumphollow’s tongue cannot move more than 10 feet away and takes a –2 penalty to AC as long as the tongue is attached. The tongue can be removed by succeeding on an opposed Strength check as an action, or by dealing 2 slashing damage to the tongue (AC 11, damage does not deplete Gumphollow’s actual hit points). Gumphollow cannot move more than 10 feet away from the target, but he can release his tongue as a free action. Unlike a giant frog, Gumphollow cannot pull a target toward him with his tongue.

actions.name: Terrifying Croak (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Gumphollow can emit a loud and horrifying croak. Any creature within 30 feet must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 3 (1d4) rounds. Creatures that succeed at this saving throw cannot be affected again by Gumphollow’s croak for 24 hours.

actions.name: Fey Leap
actions.description: As an action a sidhe may “leap” between spaces as if by dimension door. This magical transport must begin and end within 20 ft. of some illumination. A sidhe can “jump” up to a total of 20 ft. per day in 10 ft. increments (i.e., 2 10-ft. leaps or 1 20-ft. leap per day). Using this ability with a Fey-touched mount brings the mount along as part of the movement.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3)

monsters.name: Ulorian, the River King
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapons that aren't cold iron
monsters.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The River King can breathe air and water.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
The River King's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). The River King can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: create or destroy water, shocking grasp, water breathing
3/day: freedom of movement, control water
1/day: chain lightning

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
features.description: If the River King fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Weapons
features.description: The River King's weapon attacks are magical and do an extra 11 (3d6) lightning damage (included below).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The River King makes three attacks with his longsword and/or flood blast, in any combination.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage or 11 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 11 (3d6) lightning damage.

actions.name: Flood Blast
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage. A target creature must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and pushed up to 60 feet at the River King's choosing.

actions.name: Grasping Whirlpool (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: The River King magically creates a swirling vortex of water centered on a point he can see within 60 feet. The vortex fills a cylinder with a 10-foot radius and 15 feet high. Creatures in the area must make a successful DC 16 Strength saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage and be restrained and unable to breathe. On a successful save, the creature is pushed to the edge of the area. A restrained creature can escape from the whirlpool by using an action to make a successful DC 16 Strength check. A creature that's in the whirlpool at the end of its turn takes 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage in addition to any effects from being unable to breathe. Creatures with a swim speed have advantage on the saving throw and the Strength check to escape. The whirlpool lasts for 1 minute or until the River King uses this ability again.

reactions.name: Blade Current
reactions.description: When a creature within the River King's melee reach stands up from prone, the River King can make a longsword attack on that creature with advantage.

legendary_actions.name: Longsword
legendary_actions.description: The River King makes a longsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Flow
legendary_actions.description: The River King moves half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ripple (2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The River King magically ripples like sunlight on the surface of water. Until the start of his next turn, all attacks against him have disadvantage.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: Jenny can breathe both air and water.

features.name: Immutable Form
features.description: Jenny is immune to any power, other than her own, that would change her shape or alter her form.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Jenny Greenteeth's innate Spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: chill touch, command, friends, invisibility, minor illusion, poison spray
3/day: arms of Hadar, charm person, detect thoughts, ray of sickness, suggestion
1/day: bestow curse, conjure woodland beings, counterspell

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Jenny has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: Jenny can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that can hear these sounds can tell they are imitations on a successful DC 16 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Jenny makes 2 claw attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Bogwater (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Jenny can spew regurgitated swamp-water, algae and mud in a 10 ft. vomitous cone. Each creature in that area must succeed at a DC 15 Dexterity check to avoid being spattered with the leech-infested bile and acquiring the blinded condition for 1 round. Any affected target creature that does not spend 1 additional turn to remove the leeches must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw each turn to avoid acquiring 1 level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Swamp Fever
actions.description: If both Jenny's claw attacks damage the same target creature, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Constitution saving throw to avoid acquiring the poisoned condition.

features.name: Umbral Frailty
features.description: A sidhe in dim illumination or worse rolls all attack, skill-check and saving throws at disadvantage.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Flax's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.
At will: blade ward, disguise self
3/day: entangle, faerie fire, hunter's mark
1/day: haste

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Lord Flax makes 2 melee attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) slashing damage and 6 (1d10) poison damage. Flax's greatsword is coated with enough toxin for 5 successful attacks.

actions.name: Pommel Strike
actions.description: On a successful greatsword attack, Lord Flax's current target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check to avoid being knocked prone.

actions.name: Whirling Multiattack
actions.description: When Flax succeeds at a greatsword attack that does not include a pommel strike, half the damage delivered to the target is also applied to all enemies within 5 feet of the target.

actions.name: Fey Leap
actions.description: As an action, Flax may "leap" between spaces as if by dimension door. This magical transport must begin and end within 20 ft. of some illumination. He can "jump" up to a total of 20 ft. per day in 10 ft. increments (i.e., 2 10-ft. leaps or 1 20-ft. leap per day). Using this ability with a mount brings the mount along as part of the movement.

monsters.name: Ambertan the Warlock
monsters.source: Siege of the False Mill p.63

monsters.name: Ambertan

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Ambertan has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Ambertan's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma. He can cast the following spells innately, requiring no material components.
1/day: misty step (when in shadows, dim light, or darkness only)

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Ambertan is a 6th-level spellcaster. his spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). He has two 4th-level slots which he regains after a short rest, and knows the following warlock spells:
Cantrips (at will): eldritch blast, poison spray, true strike
1st level: armor of Agathys, arms of Hadar, protection from evil and good
2nd level: cloud of daggers, crown of madness
3rd level: fly
4th level: blight

features.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
features.description: While in sunlight, Ambertan has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

features.name: Traveler in Darkness
features.description: Ambertan has advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks made to know about shadow roads and shadow magic spells or items.

monsters.source: Siege of the False Mill p.64

monsters.name: Lady Budena

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Lady Budena carries a +2 silver dagger.

features.name: Alluring Presence
features.description: All humanoids within 30 feet of Lady Budena who look directly at her must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or be drawn to her in the most direct path, regardless of the danger. This compulsion fades once the person gets within 5 feet of her. A creature can avoid this effect for one full round by choosing to avert its eyes at the start of its turn, but it then has disadvantage on any attacks or other rolls directed against Lady Budena until the start of its next turn. Lady Budena can suppress or resume this ability as a bonus action. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from Lady Budena for 24 hours.

features.name: Unearthly Grace
features.description: Lady Budena applies her Charisma modifier to all her saving throws in place of the normal ability modifier.

features.name: Water Spirit
features.description: Lady Budena is under the effect of freedom of movement whenever she is in contact with a body of water.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Lady Budena is a 9th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Charisma (Spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). Lady Budena has the following sorcerer spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, poison spray, ray of frost, true strike
1st level (4 slots): detect magic, ray of sickness, shield, witch bolt
2nd level (3 slots): invisibility
3rd level (3 slots): dispel magic, protection from energy
4th level (3 slots): confusion, dominate beast, polymorph
5th level (1 slot): insect plague

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description:
Lady Budena targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see or hear her, it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be charmed by Lady Budena. The charmed target regards her as its one, true love, to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the Lady Budena's control, it takes her requests or actions in the most favorable way it can.

Each time Lady Budena or her companions cause the target to take damage, directly or indirectly, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Lady Budena is killed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

actions.name: Stunning Glance
actions.description: Lady Budena mentally disrupts a creature within 30 feet with a look. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 2 rounds. Anyone who successfully saves against this effect cannot be affected by it from Lady Budena for 24 hours.

actions.name: Firefly Storm
actions.description: The scintillating cloud of fireflies and fairy-lights that delicately mantle Lady Budena's presence are not for adornment alone. She can mentally command her "cloud" to instantly occupy any 20-ft. cube within 60 feet of her that she can see. Any creature caught inside the cloud's radius is affected by faerie fire and takes 5 (1d8) piercing damage. Targets must then succeed at a DC 14 Constitution saving throw to avoid the blinded condition (50%) or the poisoned condition (50%). Lady Budena can mentally move the cloud up to 30 ft. to another space she can see for a second attack. Afterwards, the cloud dissipates and Lady Budena must complete a short rest before using this ability again.

monsters.source: Appendix A: Courtiers of the River Court p.65

monsters.name: Wickerbell

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Wickerbell always has her +1 shortsword and a wand of wonder in her possession. Wickerbell is never without her escort of 1–2 giant honeybees and can nearly always be found mounted on the back of one of them.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Wickerbell's natural spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). She casts the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: alter self, prestidigitation
3/day: mage armor, shillelagh
1/ day: haste (self only), invisibility (self only)

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Wickerbell is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). Wickerbell has the following druid spells prepared, requiring no material components:
Cantrips (at will): poison spray, resistance, thorn whip
1st level: cure wounds, entangle, faerie fire, speak with animals
2nd level: heat metal, flame blade, hold person
3rd level: conjure animals, dispel magic, speak with plants
4th level: giant insect (bees only)

features.name: Child of the Summer Lands
features.description: Wickerbell has advantage on all saving throws versus sleep and charm and to any immobilizing spells or magical effects.

features.name: Inconspicuous
features.description: Wikerbell has advantage on all Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: +1 Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fey Leap
actions.description: As an action, Wickerbell may jump between spaces as if by dimension door. This magical transport must begin and end within 20 ft. of some illumination. She can "jump" up to 20 ft. per day in 10-ft. increments (i.e., two 10-ft. leaps or one 20-ft. leap per day). Using this ability with a mount brings the mount along as part of the movement.

monsters.source: Appendix A: Courtiers of the River Court p.66

monsters.name: Summer Lands Honeybee
languages: understands Sylvan but does not speak

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.source: Appendix A: Courtiers of the River Court p.66

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Fangs wears a cloak of elvenkind and a mithral breastplate (250 gp) and carries a +1 greatclub and a potion of speed.

features.name: Schooled in the Summer Lands
features.description: Fangs doubles his proficiency bonus and makes all rolls at advantage for any Nature, Perception, Stealth or Survival related checks made while in the wilds of the Summer Lands.

actions.name: +1 Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelins (6)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage.

features.name: Cursed Silver Urn
features.description: This silver tea urn is always full and produces any non-magical beverage on command of its wearer, from spring water to wine to piping hot tea. It weighs 300 lbs. and always counts as a heavy load. The urn can only be removed if someone honestly agrees to carry it instead of the current wearer. It produces magical effects and attacks and operates outside the Summer Lands only by the express will of the River King.

actions.name: Gushing Geyser (Cursed Urn)
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage and 12 (3d6 + 1) fire damage (scalding tea). Target must succeed at a DC 14 Dexterity check to avoid being knocked prone. A 20-foot-long, 1-foot-wide stream at 50 gallons per round sprays forth from the urn.

actions.name: Silver Chalice
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Special Equipment
features.description: Sir Lijon wears magical scarlet and silver scale mail that provides damage resistance against nonmagical piercing damage, and he wields a dagger of venom. He also carries an ornamental mithral, silver, and moonstone dueling‑dirk worth 200 gp.

features.name: Umbral Frailty
features.description: In dim illumination or worse, Sir Lijon rolls all saving throws, skill checks, and attack rolls at disadvantage.

features.name: Innate Spellcasting
features.description:
Sir Lijon’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). He may cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: disguise self
3/day: entangle, hunter’s mark
1/day: glibness (self only), haste (self only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Sir Lijon makes two melee attacks, one with his rapier and one with his dagger.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger of Venom
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage. Sir Lijon can use an action to cause poison to coat the blade. The poison remains for 1 minute or until Sir Lijon hits a creature with it. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) poison damage and become poisoned for 1 minute. The dagger can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.

actions.name: Fey Leap
actions.description: As an action, Sir Lijon may jump between spaces as if by dimension door. This magical transport must begin and end within 20 ft. of some illumination. He can “jump” up to 20 ft. per day in 10-ft. increments (i.e., two 10-ft. leaps or one 20-ft. leap per day). Using this ability with a mount brings the mount along as part of the movement.

npcs.name: Voyland
npcs.description: A vendor at the fey fair who haggles for items rather than coin. He wants items in exchange or help running off his sleazy rival, the gnome enchanter Mudflick.

npcs.name: Rhorlief
npcs.description: A 9-foot-tall wolf-like humanoid with a scraggly goat-like beard, wearing a battered brown vest with a hood. He sells scrolls and knows fey lore, but drives extremely hard, sly bargains.

npcs.name: Orelliar
npcs.description: The Mage of Time, a sidhe mage in a purple robe who sells moments, instants, and fateful seconds at the fey fair.

npcs.name: Ambertan
npcs.description: A Shadow Fey warlock with a spiral beard and curly shoes who possesses knowledge the party needs. He seeks to trick party members into accepting his badge of service to the Wicked Queen Nimurae. His full stats are on page 63.

traps.name: Weighted Net Traps

detection.detail: A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check is necessary to spot the trap

disarm.detail: A DC 15 Dexterity check successfully disarms it

traps.effect: Any creature caught in the square when the trap is triggered becomes restrained, and those that fail a DC 10 Strength saving throw are also knocked prone. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The net has AC 11 and 10 hit points.
traps.area: The square where the trap is triggered
traps.description: The tripwire for each trap is positioned three inches from the ground, stretched between two trees, and the net itself is hidden among the foliage.

traps.name: Logs
traps.trigger: A floating log is available to hang onto
traps.effect: The log is 1d6 squares long and supports the weight of one character per square of length. The character need not make a Strength (Athletics) check to stay above water. Logs move in the current as the GM chooses, 1d3 squares per round. A group of PCs working together can move a log 2 squares with a successful DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. Failing with at least one natural 1 means the log jams in river rocks, and a DC 15 Strength check is required to remove the log against the force of the current. At the DM's option, a whirlpool may form near the log, dragging characters under (see Whirlpool, below).
traps.description: A floating log hazard in the Rushing River.

traps.name: Rapids
traps.effect: PCs in difficult water have disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) checks for movement.

traps.name: River Snags
traps.trigger: An underwater tree, sharp stones, or stumps grab a PC's foot
traps.effect: This causes 1d6 slashing damage and the PC can't move for 1 round.
traps.description: Underwater obstacles that grab a PC's foot.

traps.name: Small Waterfall
traps.trigger: The river drops by 10 feet onto rocks and churning water
traps.effect: Characters with proficiency in Dexterity (Acrobatics) avoid this damage; all others take 1d6 falling damage.
traps.description: A 10-foot drop onto rocks and churning water.

traps.name: Surface Rocks
traps.trigger: The character hits a large rock
traps.effect: The character suffers 2d10 bludgeoning damage and is stunned next round.
traps.description: Large rocks on the surface that cause damage and stun.

traps.name: Whirlpool
traps.trigger: An eddy drags the character down below the surface
traps.effect: Escaping requires a successful DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check. Each round the PC fails a check, that PC remains underwater and must hold her breath or begin suffocating. It takes 1 round for an affected PC who has broken free from the eddy to swim back to the surface.
traps.description: An eddy that drags characters underwater.

traps.name: Waterfall
traps.trigger: After 4 rounds, any PCs still in the river are hurled over the waterfall

detection.detail: A DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) check to hear the thundering crash of a waterfall not far away.

traps.effect: The next round, the waters hurl him over the waterfall onto rocks below. This is a 40-foot drop for 4d6 bludgeoning damage. On the plus side, swimming out of the quiet pool past the waterfall requires only a DC 5 Strength (Athletics) check.

traps.name: Cocoon-Chest Lock
traps.trigger: Attempting to open the locked cocoon-chest of black spider silk without picking the lock, or attempting to break the chest open by force.

detection.detail: The lock is visible on the cocoon-chest.

disarm.detail: Pick the lock with a DC 15 Dexterity check using thieves' tools.

traps.effect: If anyone attempts to break the chest open by force, a swarm of spiders is released.
traps.description: The rich treasures of the Lady of Spiders are kept guarded in a locked cocoon-chest of black spider silk. Breaking the chest open by force releases a swarm of spiders.
